result:
In the labyrinth of life, we often tend to forget the beauty of simple things. Things like a wise old tree standing tall by the road, a melody of chirping birds at the break of dawn, or the serenity of a quiet lake reflecting the colors of the setting sun. Amidst the hustle and bustle of our daily routines - the unending meetings, the deadlines, the expectations - we fail to live in that very moment we are blessed with.

The world is much more than the flashy screens that consume our time and attention. Beyond those pixelated windows, there exists an ethereal world of silhouettes under the glowing moonlight, a world where the wind whispers tales in the rustle of leaves, a world where raindrops on a tin roof play symphonies of the Earth. Amidst obligations and responsibilities, we should remember to pause, breathe, and appreciate the magnificence and mysteries that surround us.

Within this fast-paced digital era, human connections are getting replaced by online profiles and emojis. The warmth of a sympathetic touch, the healing power of an understanding smile, or the comfort of a shared silence – these experiences are increasingly becoming a rarity. While technology has undoubtedly brought the world closer, it has also perhaps, distanced us from the fundamental human need to truly connect.

There's an alleluia in courageously embracing the present, letting ourselves be awed by the everyday miracles we often oversee. Regaining that sense of wonder and gratitude for life, I believe, can add more meaning and joy to our existence. Essentially, in appreciating the little things, we can find our big world.
